offerings.description: For stubborn knots from long flights, laptop days, or bad hotel pillows. Slow forearm, elbow, and thumb pressure to loosen chronic tension.

offerings.description: Made for sore paddling shoulders, tight hips, and heavy legs after surfing, the gym, yoga, or a Mount Batur hike.

offerings.description: A full Balinese massage followed by a lulur scrub of turmeric, rice powder, and spices, then a cooling yogurt or coconut moisturizer.

offerings.description: Firm thumb and finger pressure on the reflex points of your feet, plus a relaxing massage of the ankles and calves.
